pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 我叫 wǒ jiào mean when it comes before a name? (1 mark)
   A. I like
   B. I am going to
   C. Where is
   D. My name is

2. Read the pinyin: nà shì wǒ gēge. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is this?
   B. This is my father.
   C. There are five people in my family.
   D. That is my older brother.

3. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom."? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 电视在客厅。
   C. 门在左边。
   D. 电视在桌子上。

4. Which sentence means "On Friday, go to the mosque."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期天,去教堂。
   B. 星期五,去清真寺。
   C. 明天是星期四。
   D. 我星期三去学校。

5. Which word is pronounced xīngqīsān? (1 mark)
   A. 六
   B. 星期三
   C. 昨天
   D. 一

6. Which pair of numbers is easily mixed up in sound? (1 mark)
   A. sān (3) and bā (8)
   B. sì (4) and shí (10)
   C. yī (1) and èr (2)
   D. liù (6) and qī (7)

7. What does 玩 (wán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To play
   B. Candle
   C. To wish
   D. Plate

8. Which is an activity at a birthday party? (1 mark)
   A. 刮风 the wind blows
   B. 上学 going to school
   C. 切蛋糕 cutting the cake
   D. 洗手 washing hands

9. Which Chinese word means "dinner"? (1 mark)
   A. 牛肉 niúròu
   B. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   C. 午饭 wǔfàn
   D. 喜欢 xǐhuan

10. Read the pinyin: wǒ hē chá. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   B. I drink tea.
   C. I like to eat bananas.
   D. This is a banana.

11. What does 手 (shǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Shoulder
   C. Foot
   D. Hand

12. What does the broken telephone game teach? (1 mark)
   A. Careful listening
   B. Drawing
   C. Fast running
   D. Counting

13. Which Chinese word means "to touch"? (1 mark)
   A. 摸 mō
   B. 哭 kū
   C. 肩膀 jiānbǎng
   D. 用 yòng

14. Which sentence means "Today there are clouds."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天有云。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 雨很大。
   D. 今天下雨。

15. Which word means "left side"? (1 mark)
   A. 下面 xiàmiàn
   B. 右边 yòubian
   C. 左边 zuǒbian
   D. 上面 shàngmiàn

16. Which sentence means "The garden is on the right of the house."? (1 mark)
   A. 花园在房子右边。
   B. 电视在哪儿?
   C. 沙发在哪儿?
   D. 床在卧室。

17. Which sentence means "There is a television in the living room."? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室里有床。
   B. 浴室在花园旁边。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 客厅里有电视。

18. Read the pinyin: chuáng zài wòshì. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The bathroom is beside the garden.
   B. The garden is on the right of the house.
   C. Where is the television?
   D. The bed is in the bedroom.

19. What does 周 (zhōu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. School
   B. To rest
   C. Tomorrow
   D. Week (short form)

20. What does 几 (jǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To play
   B. Which number, how many
   C. Gift
   D. Everybody

21. What is a reading journal for? (1 mark)
   A. Listing chores
   B. Playing games only
   C. Storing food
   D. Keeping words and sentences you have learnt

22. Which word comes first in pinyin alphabetical order? (1 mark)
   A. xiāngjiāo
   B. chá
   C. mángguǒ
   D. bǐng

23. Which sentence means "I like to eat bananas."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是香蕉。
   B. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   C. 这是什么?
   D. 我喝茶。

24. Which Chinese word means "hand"? (1 mark)
   A. 手 shǒu
   B. 耳朵 ěrduo
   C. 用 yòng
   D. 刷牙 shuāyá

25. What does 用 (yòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To use
   B. Shoulder
   C. Two (before a counting word)
   D. Ear

26. Why do we pause when we read aloud? (1 mark)
   A. To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   B. To read faster
   C. To change tones
   D. To forget words

27. What does 唱歌 (chànggē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Date (day of the month)
   B. To sing
   C. We
   D. Candle

28. How many strokes does 米 have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 7

29. What does 肩膀 (jiānbǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To look, to see
   B. To speak
   C. Shoulder
   D. Tooth

30. Which sentence means "The rain is heavy."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 风很小。
   C. 这是太阳。
   D. 今天天气很好。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Say where the tone mark goes in these syllables: hǎo and liù. (2 marks)

32. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 风 and 鸡肉. (2 marks)

33. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my father." (2 marks)

34. Write a short conversation of three lines in which two learners greet each other, give their names and ask "And you?". Include pinyin. (5 marks)

35. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 祝 and 电视. (2 marks)

36. Why is a healthy plate made from several food groups? Give an example of a food from two groups. (3 marks)

37. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 旁边 and 您好. (2 marks)

38. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" (2 marks)

39. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" and "When is your birthday?" (4 marks)

40. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 说 and 再见. (2 marks)

41. Name one kind of extreme weather. Say what causes it and give one safety tip. (4 marks)

42. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" and "Thank you!" (4 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is in the living room." (2 marks)

44. Draw a plan of a home with a garden, door, window and sofa and write four sentences about where things are, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

45. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." and "On Wednesday I go to school." (4 marks)

46. Draw the four tone marks over the vowel a and name each tone. (3 marks)

47. Give the Chinese for mosque and church with pinyin. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — My name is
   叫 means to be called, so 我叫 introduces your name.

2. D — That is my older brother.
   nà shì wǒ gēge. is 那是我哥哥。, which means "That is my older brother.".

3. A — 床在卧室。
   床在卧室。 (chuáng zài wòshì.) means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

4. B — 星期五,去清真寺。
   星期五,去清真寺。 (xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.) means "On Friday, go to the mosque.".

5. B — 星期三
   星期三 is pronounced xīngqīsān and means Wednesday.

6. B — sì (4) and shí (10)
   sì has an s sound and shí has an sh sound.

7. A — To play
   玩 (wán) means to play.

8. C — 切蛋糕 cutting the cake
   切蛋糕 is cut the cake.

9. B — 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

10. B — I drink tea.
   wǒ hē chá. is 我喝茶。, which means "I drink tea.".

11. D — Hand
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

12. A — Careful listening
   A whispered word can change when a listener misses a sound or tone.

13. A — 摸 mō
   摸 (mō) means to touch.

14. A — 今天有云。
   今天有云。 (jīntiān yǒu yún.) means "Today there are clouds.".

15. C — 左边 zuǒbian
   左边 is the left side.

16. A — 花园在房子右边。
   花园在房子右边。 (huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.) means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

17. D — 客厅里有电视。
   客厅里有电视。 (kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.) means "There is a television in the living room.".

18. D — The bed is in the bedroom.
   chuáng zài wòshì. is 床在卧室。, which means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

19. D — Week (short form)
   周 (zhōu) means week (short form).

20. B — Which number, how many
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

21. D — Keeping words and sentences you have learnt
   A journal helps you review and check your progress.

22. D — bǐng
   b comes before c, m and x.

23. B — 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   我喜欢吃香蕉。 (wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.) means "I like to eat bananas.".

24. A — 手 shǒu
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

25. A — To use
   用 (yòng) means to use.

26. A — To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   Pauses help the reader and the listener.

27. B — To sing
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

28. A — 6
   米 has six strokes.

29. C — Shoulder
   肩膀 (jiānbǎng) means shoulder.

30. A — 雨很大。
   雨很大。 (yǔ hěn dà.) means "The rain is heavy.".

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: hǎo: on a. liù: on u (the second of iu).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风: fēng, wind. 鸡肉: jīròu, chicken (meat).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好!我叫安娜。你呢? nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ānnà. nǐ ne? A: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct greeting line and 1 mark each for the name sentences, 1 mark for correct pinyin tone marks, 5 in total.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝: zhù, to wish. 电视: diànshì, television.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Each group helps the body in a different way. For example rice gives energy and spinach gives vitamins.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 2 marks for examples.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: 旁边: pángbiān, beside. 您好: nín hǎo, hello (polite).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 说: shuō, to speak. 再见: zàijiàn, goodbye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example a flood: it is caused by too much heavy rain. Stay away from fast rivers. (A drought is caused by too little rain. Save water.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the event, 1 mark for the cause, 2 marks for a safety tip with a reason.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn! 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在客厅。 diànshì zài kètīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian. 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the plan and 1 mark for each correct sentence.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān. 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: ā first tone (high, flat), á second tone (rising), ǎ third tone (dipping), à fourth tone (falling).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct marks, 2 marks for three, 3 marks for all four with names.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì and 教堂 jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
